diagnostic_thresholds.event_active_support: any nonzero channel in the registered Gaussian-count event representation; shared union of normal EventGenesis and V2E events
diagnostic_thresholds.gt_motion: flow magnitude >= 0.5 source pixels per 30 ms interval
diagnostic_thresholds.photo_warp_candidate_mask: shared GT-valid pixels whose mapped target coordinates are in bounds for zero, GT, reverse and mistimed flow
diagnostic_thresholds.texture: Sobel gradient magnitude of linearized display luma > 1/255

ground_truth.unit: forward source-pixel displacement per 30 ms endpoint interval

linearized_display_signal.representation: gamma-2.2-decoded Genesis uint8 display RGB proxy; not native HDR radiance
linearized_display_signal.v2e_display_mapping: fixed Rec.709 linear Y from shared proxy, exposure 1, Reinhard, sRGB, uint8

photo_warp_rule: GT forward endpoint correspondence evaluates next(x+flow)->previous(x); same mask for zero, GT, reverse and mistimed flow

segmentation_visibility.interpretation: renderer segmentation pixels for registered physical object and texture links; count change is a visibility diagnostic, not a quality score

support_rule: common normal-input active union intersect shared valid GT; no event-count filtering
window_rule: independently recounted half-open event windows (t_i,t_i+3] on shared 100 Hz endpoints
